verdict.rationale: Whether Epic uses a user's data or content to train AI models is a fair privacy question for Unreal Engine, since Epic's privacy policy explicitly covers Unreal Engine and its developer tools. The pack, however, has no documented AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment. The cited privacy policy covers only general retention and access, correction and deletion rights, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
